notes.title: WHATS NEXT?
notes.content:
Well guys... i would like to tell you what im currently working on for Grimtale island.

1. In Game currency - Gold (this will be in game only and not be obtained 
    through micro transactions)

2. Traders - there will be safe zones on each island that will home traders to buy 
    resourses from and even weapons.

3. Missions - Alongside Traders there will be People you can speak to for 
    missions, these missions will be rewarded in either Gold or resourses.

4. The large island - This island will be huge, think of it as the main map. 
    players of the old version of Grimtale island will know the size of the old map, 
    this one will be bigger. 

5. co-op - co-op multiplayer will be available early 2019

These are the things im currenyly working on (alongside polish of already implimented mechanics)

I hope you like the way the game is going and i hope to see more people explore Grimtale in the near future! 

thank you all! 

michael schade - lead developer

notes.title: SUNDAYS UPDATE (INFORMATION)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

As you all know, there hasn’t been the usual update every couple of days for a little while. This is because I have been working on a brand new map and improved game mechanics.

The new map will replace the old map but will be a thousand times better in every way! You are placed on an actual island this time surrounded by ocean for a more immersive expeariance.

Here are the new features!

* A new world, build from the ground up, 4 times as big as the old map.

* dynamic fishing in lakes and rivers! 

* Farming that uses the worlds solar and weather systems to decide your crops      
  fate.

* Craftable axe (no longer a pickup) 

* Random loot spawns based on item rating system.

* zombie spawn based on noise and player location.

* zombie horde events (random zombie hordes will spawn and follow randomly generated paths, lets hope your not in the middle of it.

* painted terrain for a more detailed look

* land, water and air vehicles 

* double the performance of the old build!

I can’t wait and I hope you guys can’t either!

Thank you all for being so patient!

notes.title: UPDATE 2 ( NEW BUILD SYSTEM, HOTBAR, ANIMATIONS)
notes.content:
[u]NOTE THIS UPDATE WILL REQUIRE A NEW GAME, THIS WONT BE THE CASE IN THE FUTURE.[/u] 

[h1]NEW BUILDING SYSTEM[/h1] 

 I have changed the way the base building works in Grimtale Island. 
 now when you place an item you will go into build mode, this means that you 
 can full look around and place an item exactly where you need it.

 * Buildable items will now snap to any surface you place them on ( no more 
   spawning under the ground or in a tree trunk)

 * Press R to rotate items

 * Left mouse to Place item.

You will see a red square and a red line when in build mode this will eventually be changed to a more pleasing effect.

[h1]HOTBAR[/h1] 

* No more changing weapons, eating or drinking in the Inventory! (YAY!!!!)

* When you pick up a weapon, the weapon will automaticaly be placed on 
  your hot bar.

* Hot bar will detect if you have drink and food in inventory (only apples can 
  be eaten from hotbar at the moment)

[h1]CHANGE WEAPON ANIMATIONS[/h1] 

* When you change a weapon on your hot bar it will play an animation and 
  will stop player from using weapon for a short period untill the player has the 
  weapon equipt 


[u]FROM THIS POINT ON, UPDATES WILL CONTAIN MORE CONTENT AND FIXES, THESE UPDATES I FELT HAD TO BE PUT OUT EARLYER FOR THE ENJOYMENT OF THE GAME[/u]

notes.title: Performance Patch
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I have some Great news regarding Grimtale Islands Performance.
 
People with lower end systems should see a major improvemet in FPS while playing Grimtale Island.

The reason people where having fps drops was because the whole map was being renderd at all times no matter where the player was, this has now been changed and the map will only render objects at a certain distance from the player. This will be inplimented as a view distance slider in the graphics menu at a later date. 

(FOR THIS PATCH TO TAKE EFFECT PLAYERS WILL NEED TO START A NEW GAME)

thank you 

Michael Schade - Developer
